name: Glowing Scorpid Blood
label: Quest
description: Glowing Scorpid Blood: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: In all my time working the Faire, I've learned a lot of things about customers. Here's one of those nuggets of wisdom: customers love stuff that glows! It doesn't matter what it is - you could take a broken chair leg and make it glow, and every child will come from miles around to get one!
So, friend, I need glowing scorpid blood. You can find it from the scorpids of Sillithus, or the Blasted Lands, or the Burning Steppes.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great job, friend! Thanks a lot! I'm going to make paint from this blood and turn all kinds of cheap junk into glowing treasure!
Here are your tickets, and thanks again!
